comment: The CV scalings are all in process() at Proteus.cpp:370-385 and none of them is a volt per unit: length moves three steps per volt because maxSteps/10 is integer division, lambda is cast to int before scaling so it only responds in whole volts, and density, octave and mutate each move ten percentage points per volt. The gate knob is configured from 0.05 but the clamp after the CV sum has a floor of 0.1, so the shortest gate reachable with any CV patched is a tenth of the clock gap, and no gate is ever shorter than 10ms (line 518). The source comment beside mode 1 at line 419 says "allow to regen but no mutations", which is the wrong way round: that setting sets mutate true and accumulate false, so note changes carry on and new melodies stop, as the maker's README says.
